card.name: Surgery and postoperative setting words
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifying words right after a mention of surgery or the postoperative period, such as "associated with", "risk of", "undergoing", "surgical". It is strongest just before thromboembolism or surgical-field terms.

modes.label: Link before clot risk
modes.description: Linking word after surgery that leads into increased thromboembolism risk.
modes.example: estrogens should be discontinued at least 4 to 6 weeks before surgery of the type associated<< with>> an increased risk of thromboembol
